title: Inspect the operator-table starter
description: You can read the supplied parser and its consumption report before adding operator rules.

steps.description: The tokenizer groups digits and recognizes the listed two-character comparison tokens. Other characters become individual tokens.
BINDING currently contains arithmetic operators. The commented tasks leave additional operator entries for you to supply.
parse_expr returns a tree and its stopping position. An operator absent from BINDING ends the loop.
show formats each constructed node with parentheses. A plain token becomes its own displayed text.

steps.question: What does consumed report when pos is short of the token count?
steps.answer: It reports only followed by the number of tokens consumed.

steps.description: As supplied, the first input consumes all tokens and the other two stop early. The remaining comments leave the table additions and language decisions to you.
